title: Clawd X Digest
summary: SpaceX Orbital Dominance: Eric Trump highlighted data showing SpaceX launched 80–85% of all global mass to orbit in 2025, dwarfing national programs like China (8–10%).

Frontier AI Pretraining & Releases: Reports indicate OpenAI is preparing to launch its next major pretrain model 'Astra', while Sam Altman announced Sol 5.6 performance updates and unlimited text chat for free tier users.

Macro Energy & Market Signals: Financial markets reacted to signals on potential oil price shifts, euro futures pullbacks to 1.1520, and comments from AMD CEO Lisa Su on accelerating AI adoption speed.
Quant Finance & Formal Proofs: A historical account of Harry Markowitz's 1955 dissertation defense before Milton Friedman gained traction alongside Lean-verified spacetime research.

Tech Tools & Entertainment Highlights: Phantom Blade Zero announced pre-orders and an 11-minute trailer, Warp launched custom model routers, and Nader Dabit shared 60-second Mac cloud environments for AI agents.

items.title: @EricTrump: SpaceX Dominates Global Orbital Mass
items.body: Eric Trump shared orbital launch statistics showing SpaceX accounted for 80-85% of all mass launched to orbit globally in 2025, underscoring private sector leadership vs national space programs like China (8-10%).

items.title: @synthwavedd: OpenAI Prepares 'Astra' Model Launch
items.body: Exclusive reports indicate OpenAI is preparing to launch 'Astra', their next major pretrain frontier model, targeting an imminent release.

items.title: @sama: Sol 5.6 Improvements & Free Unlimited Chat
items.body: Sam Altman announced significant performance improvements for 5.6 Sol in chat along with expanded unlimited text chat access for free tier users.

items.title: @dabit3: Real Mac Cloud Environments for AI Agents
items.body: Nader Dabit demonstrated a 60-second setup giving Cloud AI Agents clean, real macOS environments with Xcode and iOS Simulator for agentic mobile development.

items.title: @muellerberndt: Lean-Verified Spacetime Proofs
items.body: Bernhard Mueller highlighted OPH, an open, auditable research effort with formal Lean proofs and simulations testing whether finite observers force spacetime geometry and the Standard Model.

items.title: @warpdotdev: Custom Model Routers in Warp
items.body: Warp Terminal introduced custom plain-English AI model routing rules, enabling developers to direct simple prompts, planning tasks, and bug fixes to optimal models dynamically.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Executive Signals on Energy & Oil Prices
items.body: Market commentators noted statements from President Trump indicating potential policy moves that could send oil prices higher, influencing broader inflation expectations.

items.title: @YahooFinance: AMD CEO on Accelerating AI Adoption Pace
items.body: AMD CEO Lisa Su emphasized that the rate and pace of enterprise AI adoption is moving significantly faster than initial industry projections.

items.title: @CMEActiveTrader: Euro Futures Pullback & Dollar Strength
items.body: Euro futures reversed from weekly highs of 1.1560 to 1.1520 amidst a strengthening U.S. dollar and rising energy costs ahead of key employment reports.

items.title: @castlehedge: The Origin Story of Modern Portfolio Theory
items.body: A detailed historical account traced Harry Markowitz's 1955 dissertation defense before Milton Friedman and Jacob Marschak, marking the birth of quantitative finance.

items.title: @BlaineACII: DOJ Rescinds ISS Governance Exemption
items.body: The Department of Justice rescinded a 1987 letter granting ISS governance long-standing proxy advisory exemptions, impacting corporate governance standards.

items.title: @pbzero_official: Phantom Blade Zero 11-Minute Showcase
items.body: Action RPG Phantom Blade Zero announced pre-orders and a comprehensive 11-minute gameplay trailer scheduled for August 11.

items.title: @Real_Moviescene: Zoolander Classic Improvisation Detail
items.body: A popular movie analysis post shared how Ben Stiller's accidental line repetition in Zoolander (2001) resulted in one of comedy cinema's most iconic unscripted moments.

items.title: @FBAwayDays: N'Golo Kanté's Saudi Philanthropy Impact
items.body: Midfielder N'Golo Kanté reflected on his journey and philanthropic commitments to supporting communities back home through his sports earnings.
